# Prayer & Family Virtues

This site contains a personal prayer for growth and character and the Ward Family Virtues.
It is a separate personal values page connected from RichWard.org.

## Canonical URL
- https://virtues.richward.org/

## Main sections
- Prayer for Growth & Character: a personal prayer adapted and revised from a prayer by John C. Maxwell in *Developing the Leader Within You 2.0*.
- Ward Family Virtues: four family virtues: Stewardship through Servant Leadership, Joy + Positivity, Peace with Patience, and Grace + Forgiveness.

## Ward Family Virtues
- Stewardship through Servant Leadership: Goodness, Faithfulness
- Joy + Positivity: Joy
- Peace with Patience: Peace, Patience, Gentleness, Self-Control
- Grace + Forgiveness: Love, Kindness

## Related site
- Rich Ward public-service website: https://richward.org/
